title: Interpolating Sequences For Dual Uniform Algebras
summary: Given a dual uniform algebra $A=X^*$ with maximal ideal space $M_A$, we provide the first sufficient condition in terms of the Gleason distance of $A$ for a sequence in $M_A\cap X$ to be interpolating for $A$. We prove that a sequence in $\mathbb{D}^N$ is uniformly separated if and only if it is interpolating for $H^\infty(\mathbb{D}^N)$ and its sequence of norms satisfies the Blaschke condition, and then use this characterization to classify the interpolating sequences for $H^\infty(\mathbb{D}^N)$ in terms of its Gleason distance.
